BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to simplifying motor voter registration; amendingRCW 29A.08.340 and 46.20.155; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that voterparticipation is the foundation of our democracy. The legislature alsorecognizes that young people register to vote at much lower rates thanany other age group. Therefore, the legislature intends to enhancevoter participation by simplifying motor voter registration.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.08.340 and 2003 c 111 s 225 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) ((A person may register to vote, transfer a voter registration,or change his or her name for voter registration purposes when he orshe applies for or renews a driver's license or identification cardunder chapter 46.20 RCW. (2) To register to vote, transfer his or her voter registration, orchange his or her name for voter registration purposes under thissection, the applicant shall provide the information required by RCW29A.08.210. p. 1 SB 6129 (3) The driver licensing agent shall record that the applicant hasrequested to register to vote or transfer a voter registration.))Applications for a driver's license and a state identicard shall alsoserve as an application for voter registration purposes. (2) The voter registration component of the driver's licenseapplication and the application for a state identicard must contain theminimum information required under RCW 29A.08.810 necessary to placethe applicant on the voter registration rolls. (3) An applicant for a driver's license or a state identicard maydecline in writing to be registered to vote. (4) A change of address form submitted to the department oflicensing shall serve as notification of change of address for voterregistration purposes unless the registrant states on the form that thechange of address is not for voter registration purposes. (5) Applications for voter registrations received under thissection shall be electronically transferred to the secretary of stateand shall be considered a registration by mail.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.20.155 and 2009 c 369 s 42 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) ((Before issuing an original license or identicard or renewinga license or identicard under this chapter, the licensing agent shalldetermine if the applicant wants to register to vote or transfer his orher voter registration by asking the following question: "Do you want to register to vote or transfer your voterregistration?" If the applicant chooses to register or transfer a registration,the agent shall ask the following: (1) "Are you a United States citizen?" (2) "Are you or will you be eighteen years of age on or before thenext election?" If the applicant answers in the affirmative to both questions, theagent shall then submit the registration or transfer. If the applicantanswers in the negative to either question, the agent shall not submita voter registration application.)) The department, in cooperation withthe secretary of state, must develop an application form for a driver's SB 6129 p. 2 license and a state identicard that meets the requirements of RCW29A.08.340 and 29A.08.810. (2) The department shall establish a procedure that substantiallymeets the requirements of subsection (1) of this section whenpermitting an applicant to renew a license or identicard by mail or byelectronic commerce.
